places.name: Arunachaleswarar Temple
places.blurb: A massive historic Shiva temple at the base of the sacred Arunachala hill drawing millions of pilgrims.

places.name: Sathanur Dam
places.blurb: A picturesque dam built across the Pennaiyar River featuring gardens and a crocodile farm.

places.name: Gingee Fort
places.blurb: A dramatic and nearly impregnable hill fortress complex often called the Troy of the East.

places.name: Golden Temple Sripuram
places.blurb: A sprawling spiritual complex featuring a main temple covered entirely in gold foil.

places.name: Vellore Fort
places.blurb: A sixteenth-century granite fortress renowned for its grand ramparts, moat, and ancient temple.

places.name: Jalakandeswarar Temple
places.blurb: A magnificent Vijayanagara-era temple located inside the historic Vellore Fort.

places.name: Auroville
places.blurb: An experimental universal township dedicated to human unity and sustainable living.

places.name: Yercaud
places.blurb: A charming hill station nestled in the Shevaroy Hills known for its cool climate and coffee plantations.

places.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
places.blurb: A breathtaking UNESCO World Heritage site featuring ancient structural rock-cut temples by the sea.

places.name: Skandashramam
places.blurb: A peaceful mountain cave on Arunachala where Ramana Maharshi spent several years in meditation.
